r19.text: Your ticket round robin rules apply after the direct assignment rules have been checked. Direct assignment rules are organization-wide and assign tickets based on criteria like department, channel, or priority. If no direct assignment rule applies, then the department's round robin rules share tickets among agents or teams in that department. This ensures tickets are distributed fairly among available agents or teams.
